title: Design System: Jithesh Shaju P Portfolio

display.purpose: The name in the hero and the closing line in Contact. Uppercase, Archivo at 125% width.

headline.purpose: One per section, sentence case, Archivo at 116% width. Nothing sits above it.

title.purpose: Role titles and the degree, Archivo at 108% width.

lead.purpose: Hero sentence, first paragraph of About, stated outcomes and impact lines.

body.purpose: Reading text, capped at 68ch, usually in Muted.

small.purpose: Field labels and secondary lines at 400; block sub-headings at 600.

data.purpose: JetBrains Mono for dates, stack names, stage names, and machine labels. 0.75rem inside label chips.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Default easing for every state change, entrance, and drawn stroke.

motion.name: ease-in-quart
motion.purpose: Accelerating approach inside the collision figure only.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Button press offset (1px down) and hero label colour change.

motion.name: colour
motion.purpose: Hover colour on buttons and links; frame colour on lock.

motion.name: stage-link
motion.purpose: Lime fill travelling along a pipeline connector.

motion.name: tick-draw
motion.purpose: Corner ticks drawing out to a closed frame (380ms on hero labels).

motion.name: nav-marker
motion.purpose: The locked frame sliding between nav links.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Case-study disclosure height, and the interval between pipeline stages in a trace.

motion.name: entrance-line
motion.purpose: Hero name lines rising from a clip, once on load.

motion.name: entrance-settle
motion.purpose: Hero supporting content fading up 0.75rem, once on load.

motion.name: figure-draw
motion.purpose: SVG strokes drawing in when a figure enters view.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion all durations collapse, figures show their final state, the 3D field renders on demand, and pipelines do not auto-trace.

narrative.status: Unconfirmed. North Star, overview voice, and colour display names were written from the shipped build without the owner's confirmation round.
narrative.overview:
The page is what a detection model sees when it looks at one career. A blue-black ground holds a field of data points that enter scattered, pass through a network, and leave in ordered rows. Over that field, the things that matter are picked out the way a detector picks out a target: four corner ticks at rest, a closed box and a label when attention lands. The interface has no other ornament. Everything that looks like decoration is a diagram of something, and everything that lights up does so because it is being attended to.

The mood is dark, quiet, and exact. Type is large and wide-set but the page is sparse: one column of reading, hairline rules between entries, a single tinted panel where a figure or a fact sheet needs a ground. Colour is rationed. Blue belongs to the data. Lime belongs to the lock. Everything else is ink, off-white, and two greys. Motion follows the same logic: ticks draw out to a box, a signal travels from one stage to the next, and everything eases out exponentially and then stays still.
keyCharacteristics: Blue-black ground, off-white type, zero radius, zero shadow.
One component language: the annotation frame (corner ticks at rest, closed box on lock).
Lime appears only on a lock and on the path that feeds it.
One type family (Archivo) whose width axis carries the hierarchy; mono only for data.
Hairline rules and open space separate content; tinted panels are reserved for figures and fact sheets.
A fixed 3D data field sits behind the hero and returns, dimmed, behind Contact.
Complete without WebGL, on a phone, and with reduced motion.

rules.name: The Lock Rule
rules.body: Lime means attention is here. It appears on a locked target, on the path that feeds that target, and as the hover and focus response of a control. It is never a resting fill, a heading colour, or decoration.

rules.name: The Blue Is Data Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue colours data marks: points, nodes, edges, bounding boxes. It never fills a control or a surface.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is a lightness step of the same blue-black. No neutral grey, no pure black, no pure white.

rules.name: The Width Is Rank Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is set by Archivo's width axis together with size: 125% display, 116% headline, 108% title and label, 100% for everything read. Do not introduce a second sans family to make a heading feel different.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Mono appears only where the page reports a value or a machine label: a date, a stack item, a stage name, a detector's class label. Never for prose, headings, or buttons.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separate entries with a 1px rule and space. A tinted panel is for a figure or a fact sheet, never a wrapper around ordinary content.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow or blurs what is behind it. A surface is distinguished by a lightness step or a frame.

rules.name: The Ghost Tick Rule
rules.body: Anything that can lock shows its four corner ticks before it does. The unlit state is designed, never blank.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: Zero radius on every container and control. Circles are data points only.

dos: Do build every new interactive or highlighted element from the annotation frame: corner ticks at rest, closed 1px lime box on lock, ticks drawing out over 420ms with `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`.
Do keep lime for attention only: a lock, the path feeding it, hover, and focus. Put only Lock Ink (#0b1005) on a lime fill.
Do give a Frame control's resting ticks the Faint colour (#7e8aa3) so its boundary is visible before hover.
Do set hierarchy with Archivo's width axis: 125% display, 116% headline, 108% title and label, normal width for reading text.
Do separate entries with a 1px Line rule and generous space, and cap reading text at 68ch.
Do keep every interactive target at least 2.75rem tall and keep the 2px lime focus outline.
Do make every diagram a true picture of something in the content, drawn in the system's tokens, with lime only on its locked target.
Do keep the page complete when WebGL is missing and when motion is reduced: the static network drawing and the final state of every animation must stand on their own.
Do keep tertiary text at Faint or brighter; Strong Line and Line are for strokes.
donts: Don't round a corner. No border radius on any container, control, chip, or focus ring.
Don't add box shadows, glows, blur, or glass panels. Depth is a lightness step of ink or a frame.
Don't use lime as a resting fill, a heading colour, or decoration.
Don't fill a control or a surface with Signal Blue; blue is for data marks.
Don't set prose, headings, or button labels in mono.
Don't wrap ordinary content in a tinted panel; panels are for figures and fact sheets.
Don't put a small label above a section headline. Headlines stand alone.
Don't bounce, spin, or loop. Motion eases out exponentially, plays once, and rests.
Don't introduce a second sans family, a neutral grey, pure black, or pure white.
